scenes.title: Direct current flows through a load

vo.text: A solar panel turns sunlight directly into electricity for your home.
vo.speak: A solar panel turns sunlight directly into electricity for your home.

vo.text: The working part is not the glass cover; it is the thin solar cell underneath.
vo.speak: The working part is not the glass cover; it is the thin solar cell underneath.

vo.text: When sunlight enters the solar cell, photons transfer energy to electrons in the silicon.
vo.speak: When sunlight enters the solar cell, photons transfer energy to electrons in the silicon.

vo.text: That energy frees some electrons, leaving behind positively charged vacancies called holes.
vo.speak: That energy frees some electrons, leaving behind positively charged vacancies called holes.

vo.text: A built-in electric field inside the solar cell pushes the freed electrons in one direction.
vo.speak: A built-in electric field inside the solar cell pushes the freed electrons in one direction.

vo.text: Metal contacts collect those electrons and send their flow through an external circuit as direct current.
vo.speak: Metal contacts collect those electrons and send their flow through an external circuit as direct current.

vo.text: The moving electrons can power a load before returning to the solar cell.
vo.speak: The moving electrons can power a load before returning to the solar cell.

vo.text: For many home appliances, an inverter changes the solar panel's direct current into alternating current.
vo.speak: For many home appliances, an inverter changes the solar panel's direct current into alternating current.

vo.text: So the solar panel supplies electricity because sunlight frees charges and the cell guides their flow.
vo.speak: So the solar panel supplies electricity because sunlight frees charges and the cell guides their flow.
